question: How should the collector and historical rows be repaired without converting already-Celsius values twice? Has that repair shipped?

criteria.instruction: Use the unit-aware collector, test C/F/unknown and threshold cases, retain original reports and conversion revision. Repair history using raw value/unit and known conversion provenance; do not blanket-convert all canonical rows. Quarantine ambiguous history and inventory raw coverage. c32 is approved but not deployed in the inspection.
Cite collector inspection and repair review or T6. Explain why changing only the dashboard suffix does not repair storage or alert evaluation.
Do not claim deployment, full historical repair or complete raw-coverage inventory. Do not infer conversion status from value magnitude alone.
